posts.text: I’ve known Will for years. Since my time at March for Our Lives and his at Sunrise, we’ve Organized together on some of our nation’s toughest issues. I’m proud to endorse him in his race for Congress.
posts.summary: Endorses Will for Congress based on shared organizing experience
